excluded_or_unverified.item: Asha's HealthBench Professional, Hard, and psychosis-bench evaluations

excluded_or_unverified.item: ClinicalT5: MedNLI, RadQA, CLIP; MIMIC III/IV
excluded_or_unverified.reason: OpenEvidence-affiliated authors evaluate ClinicalT5: MedNLI tests entailment, RadQA extractive radiology QA, and CLIP follow-up classification. MIMIC is pretraining material. No equivalence with the search product is established.
Methods explicitly say the models will be tested; a protocol is not a reported completed evaluation.
OpenEvidence generated synthetic cases; ChatGPT was the evaluated answering system.

excluded_or_unverified.item: Two illustrative medication questions; one cerebral-microhemorrhage case
excluded_or_unverified.reason: Review examples and single-case appraisal are documented demonstrations, not reusable multi-item benchmark sets in this inventory.

excluded_or_unverified.item: PubMed, medRxiv, NEJM, JAMA, NCCN and other retrieval/training collections
excluded_or_unverified.reason: Retrieval or content licensing alone does not establish held-out benchmark use. Guideline-derived evaluated questions are separately listed above.
